nodes.label: Token economy (caveman, ponytail, context-mode, RTK)
nodes.rationale: Large hexdumps and logs go through context-mode instead of entering the context whole.

nodes.label: Autonomous agent debug loop
nodes.rationale: Agent decides what to read, reads, interprets and picks next read itself, instead of a human pasting ps4debug reports into prompts.

nodes.label: ps4-mcp server
nodes.rationale: Does not reimplement debug primitives; adds the missing MCP tool layer and event orchestration on top of ps4debug.

nodes.label: Agent loop runs on PC
nodes.rationale: Claude Code needs Node.js, shell, git, subagents, port source and REA; an on-console agent would lose these without gaining extra console access.

nodes.label: Write tools (disabled by default)
nodes.rationale: An agent writing memory or kernel can crash the console; require manual confirmation per call.

nodes.label: Event queue (asyncio.Queue)
nodes.rationale: Model takes seconds per response so it cannot watch memory continuously; background task fills a queue that wait_for_event consumes.

nodes.label: Event snapshot format
nodes.rationale: Rich prebuilt package avoids the agent needing ten calls to understand context.

nodes.label: Phase 5 value test
nodes.rationale: Report with time-to-cause, call count and hypothesis accuracy decides whether the project continues.

nodes.label: Security policy (LAN only, audit log, limits)
nodes.norm_label: security policy (lan only, audit log, limits)

nodes.label: Pausing alters timing (race bugs vanish)
nodes.rationale: Use watchpoints and logs instead of breakpoints for timing bugs.

nodes.label: Kingdom Hearts 3 PT-BR subtitle pilot
nodes.rationale: Distributed only as a patch from a legitimate copy; agent used as investigation tool, translation itself is human-reviewed.

nodes.label: PS4 interface app (phase 6, optional)
nodes.rationale: Foreground app is suspended when a game opens, unlike Sony-integrated services; overlay out of scope.
